complexity.notes: Shadows the builtin name 'dict' with the local variable. A set with early exit on first repeated value would be simpler, use one pass, and allow early termination. Worst case degrades to O(n^2) because keys are attacker-controlled integers susceptible to adversarial hash collisions.
complexity.summary: Builds a frequency dictionary over nums in one pass, then makes a second pass to find any value with count greater than 1.
